scope: Provider-neutral objective tracker bindings, explicit imports, atomic publications and production dispatch/reconciliation with deterministic providers; no Rei runtime or public tracker routes.

qualified_behaviors: Binding admission requires current objective and connection-use authority; passive external links confer none.
Source versions, payload digests and connection target fingerprints fence observations and publications; old incarnations remain configurable for reconciliation.

Proposal decisions use the actor-pinned existing objective owner and share one append transaction with tracker receipts/publications. Local divergence requires explicit rebasing; imports invalidate real checkpoint versions.
A child process exits after commit and reconnect recovers one binding, objective receipt and publication with provider access poisoned.
Concurrent admissions and dispatch claims serialize. Rollback and corruption cannot retain a false objective receipt or publication.
Strong providers replay the immutable request only under retained unexpired server keys. Weak providers quarantine unknown effects without another send.
Unknown work blocks later sends only for its binding; suppression preserves uncertainty. Settled non-application and definitely-not-sent are distinct from empty eventual reads.
Operator attestation requires explicit local-operator reconciliation permission and retained provider-read evidence matching publication, attempt, incarnation, resource, digest and receipt revision.
Late exact acknowledgements settle their original attempt; current revocation precedes receipt disclosure.
